_comment: Non-ATAR admission routes. Three of six MVP universities lead with these, and they read Year 11 results. A tool modelling only prerequisites describes a minority of how NSW admission works.

schemes.name: Leaders and Achievers Early Entry
schemes.quote: Year 11 academic performance alongside your extracurricular activities, casual work experience and community involvement

schemes.name: HSC True Reward
schemes.quote: admission on ATAR release day based on specific HSC subject band outcomes rather than the ATAR itself
schemes._note: IMPORTANT: subject choice -> bands -> admission, bypassing the ATAR. This is readiness-shaped, not scaling-shaped. It is the second reason the maths band input is core rather than optional.

schemes.name: Early Admission
schemes.quote: your unique skills and experiences, alongside your Year 11 results
